usage:
cfb —— Chis flash burner CLI (Rust) Usage: cfb [options] Commands: detect [--json] List connected burners select [--port P] [--clear] Pick and remember a burner disconnect Disconnect and forget the burner voltage [3v3|5v|off|auto] Remember/show the supply-voltage preference info [--port P] [--mbc] Read flash + cartridge/game info rom-info --file Parse a local ROM header offline burn --rom [--mbc] Write ROM (--mbc for GB/GBC) erase [--mbc] Erase ROM (whole-chip) dump --out [--mbc] Dump ROM to a file (--len for byte count) rtc [--mbc] Read cartridge RTC save-dump --out [--mbc] [--type T] [--len N] Dump the save save-write --file [--mbc] [--type T] Write the save save-verify --file [--mbc] [--type T] Verify the save profile [list|path] List/locate flash profiles (chip command-sequence config) version [--json] Show version help Show help Global options: --lang Language (remembered; default follow system) --json Emit an NDJSON event stream (for JS clients) --port

Target port; omit to use remembered/auto-detected --mbc Operate on a GB/GBC(MBC) cart (default GBA) burn options: --chip-erase --no-ppb --no-verify save --type: sram (default) | flash | fram | batteryless (MBC: sram/fram only) When --port is omitted, the burner saved via `cfb select` is used, otherwise it is auto-detected by VID/PID (0483/0721).
op.no_rom: Specify the ROM to burn with --rom <file>.
save.type_invalid: Invalid save type '{v}' (use sram / flash / fram / batteryless).
save.not_found: No batteryless save found (no '<3 from Maniac' magic in ROM).
profile.path_hint: External profile dir: {dir} (drop flashGBX fc_*.txt or custom .json here)
disconnect.ok: Disconnected (cartridge powered off, remembered port cleared).
info.err_read: Could not read chip ID (check the cartridge is seated and the burner is OK).
info.no_cartridge: No cartridge detected (flash did not respond; check it is seated and powered).
rom_info.unrecognized: File is too small or the ROM format is unrecognized.
select.need_port_json: select cannot be interactive in --json mode; pass --port.
todo.with_port: {cmd} is not implemented yet (would use port {port}; protocol layer to be ported from C#).
todo.no_port: {cmd} is not implemented yet, and no burner is currently detected.
